plan: My private value is $14. In a second-price sealed bid auction, the optimal strategy is often to bid close to my true value. Since the prize is drawn randomly and this is a one-round game, I want to maximize my chances of winning while not overpaying. I'll bid slightly above my value to increase winning probability, but not so high that I risk negative earnings if I win. A bid around $15-16 seems strategic.
